query:
-- Verify the override
SELECT eventName, year, attendance, notes FROM event_overrides ORDER BY eventName, year;

-- Pull monthly attendance data to compute what the estimates would be for each special event year
-- Easter is in April, Christmas in December, Mother's Day in May, Back to School in August
SELECT year, month, campus, subgroup, avg_weekly 
FROM attendance_monthly 
WHERE month IN (4, 5, 8, 12) 
  AND subgroup = 'Total'
  AND campus = 'All Campuses'
ORDER BY year DESC, month
